findings.claim: The contractless mode only emits public read-write members, so public get-only properties and readonly fields are skipped. ContractlessStandardResolver (the dynamic mode users have today) includes these members, which are serialized and restored through a constructor. A user switching to this attribute would get different wire content. Separately, a class with no parameterless constructor is rejected with MsgPack005 and gets no formatter at all.

receipt_plan.detail: Serialize a type with `public int A {get;set;}` and `public int B {get;}` (set in the constructor) using ContractlessStandardResolver, then using the generated formatter. Compare the bytes; the generated output will lack key B.

findings.claim: Contractless mode sorts members by ordinal name, and it ignores any [DataContract]/[DataMember]/[MessagePackObject]/[Key] attributes on T. The requirement says T's own attributes must be honoured when present. The implementation honours only surrogate attributes, so a T with [Key] or [DataMember] gets contractless string keys. This differs from the dynamic resolver's output for the same T.

receipt_plan.detail: Take a T annotated with [MessagePackObject] and [Key(0)]/[Key(1)] in a referenced assembly. Serialize it with the dynamic resolver, then with the [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] formatter. The dynamic output is an array, while the generated output is a map with name keys.

findings.claim: The attribute-based exclusion of user-declared formatters in the hand-written formatter scan runs per candidate class. Hand-written formatters that happen to be partial and annotated are now silently dropped from the generated resolver. Also, the diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are Error severity and are newly reported only for opted-in classes, so this should not affect existing users. However, Collect is called without an accessibility guard on the generated partial's own declared accessibility: the template emits `partial class` with no accessibility modifier. Combined with the user's `public partial class`, the generated formatter may be inaccessible if the formatter is nested, or its resolver registration may not compile in an internal resolver.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a snapshot test with a public partial formatter annotated with the attribute, plus a resolver-generating assembly. Check that the generated resolver references the formatter correctly and that the build has no errors.

findings.claim: The new diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are added to the analyzer's SupportedDiagnostics, but nothing in the diff updates AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md or adds doc/analyzers pages. The help links point to missing docs. The RS2000 release-tracking analyzer would fail the build with warnings-as-errors.

receipt_plan.detail: Check that src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md has no MsgPack019-022 entries; the build would report RS2000.
